effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your effects places a digivolution card under this Digimon, this Digimon gets +3000 DP and gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[When Attacking] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon is [RagnaLoardmon], it doesn't activate [Security] effects on Option cards it checks.
